name: Mercenaries
background: The Guilds of the Nexus are various factions of violent and deranged outlaws that wage eternal guild wars on the streets of the Nexus. These guilds are joined by mercenaries which are not bound to any particular guild, and which fight for anyone that can provide riches or a worthy cause.

specialRules.name: Repel Ambushers
specialRules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Charge. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Battle-Hardened
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Increased Shooting Range Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get +6" range when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Regeneration Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman Aura
specialRules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 nearest friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Marksman. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

specialRules.name: Valiant
specialRules.description: If most models in this unit have this rule, the first time they are attacked each round, they get +1 to Morale Test rolls.

specialRules.name: Ambush
specialRules.description: Only deploys D3 rounds afters its wave, and at the start of the round it's placed within 6” of a random AI Goal.

specialRules.name: Piercing Charge
specialRules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when charging.

specialRules.name: Regeneration
specialRules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

specialRules.name: Piercing Marksman
specialRules.description: When shooting at enemies over 9" away, this model's weapons get AP(+1).

specialRules.name: Surge
specialRules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

specialRules.name: AP
specialRules.description: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits.
